answer.text: Buying convertible bonds and hedging via short positions in the underlying stock

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Convertible arbitrage buys convertibles (typically undervalued) and shorts the underlying stock to hedge equity risk, profiting from mispricing. **The Trap:** Other definitions don't capture the strategy. **Cross-Exam Context:** Common derivatives-based strategy. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Monitor delta hedge ratios closely — mispricing can unwind quickly.
